topics.text: The hotel is situated in a serene mountainous area with breathtaking views of surrounding bamboo forests and mountains. Its remote yet accessible location offers a peaceful retreat, with nearby trails and a 10-minute taxi ride to downtown.

Staff and owners are repeatedly praised for their kindness, helpfulness, and attentiveness. They provide guidance on local trails, accommodate special requests, and ensure guests feel welcomed and comfortable throughout their stay.

The setting is characterized by natural beauty, tranquility, and a harmonious blend of rustic charm and modern comforts. Guests appreciate the peaceful atmosphere, fresh air, and opportunities for relaxation in scenic outdoor spaces.
Rooms, bathrooms, and communal areas are highlighted as exceptionally clean and well-maintained, with frequent attention to hygiene standards, including clean pool water and sanitized facilities.
